abstract: Audits marine fauna acoustic safety protocols and regional seabed disturbance authorizations
system_message:
You are the Marine environmental compliance officer (ENV). Your business responsibility is to audit marine fauna acoustic safety protocols and regional seabed disturbance authorizations across evaluated subsea units.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Benthic turbidity monitoring（TURB）
information_points.content:
ENV-TURB-5J6：According to the benthic baseline assessment for the continental shelf seabed buffer zone, the baseline water column turbidity threshold for the Gavia Coastal Inspection Vehicle is 25 NTU under non-operational conditions.
ENV-TURB-R1A：According to the benthic baseline assessment for the continental shelf seabed buffer zone, the baseline water column turbidity threshold for the Kongsberg Munin Autonomous Explorer is 15 NTU under non-operational conditions.
ENV-TURB-XQX：According to the benthic baseline assessment for the continental shelf seabed buffer zone, the baseline water column turbidity threshold for the Hugin Endurance Deepwater AUV is 5 NTU under non-operational conditions.

information_points.title: Audits marine fauna acoustic safety protocols and regional seabed disturbance authorizations（BIO）
information_points.content:
ENV-BIO-2FB：For the Gavia Coastal Inspection Vehicle, the environmental impact mitigation filing indicates that the marine mammal acoustic disturbance mitigation protocol is not approved for the investigation high-frequency acoustic emitter operating envelope, lacking formal sign-off on marine mammal observer soft-start ramp-up procedures.
ENV-BIO-XLA：For the Hugin Endurance Deepwater AUV, the environmental impact mitigation filing confirms that the marine mammal acoustic disturbance mitigation protocol is approved for the investigation high-frequency acoustic emitter operating envelope, with formal sign-off on marine mammal observer soft-start ramp-up procedures.
ENV-BIO-WPR：For the Kongsberg Munin Autonomous Explorer, the environmental impact mitigation filing confirms that the marine mammal acoustic disturbance mitigation protocol is approved for the investigation high-frequency acoustic emitter operating envelope, including formal sign-off on marine mammal observer soft-start ramp-up procedures.
